_about: LOCAL-706 (D667) — Generic foreign-name pronunciation lexicon. Each entry gives the canonical written form (diacritics intact, family-name-first where applicable), an optional IPA string, an English respelling, and verified sources. Consumed by vietnamese_name_aid.py for BOTH TTS paths: AWS Polly (SSML <phoneme>/<sub>) and Kokoro/misaki (inline [name](/IPA/) markup, or respelling substitution when IPA is absent). The on-screen/narration TEXT is never changed by this lexicon — only the audio request. Not Vietnamese-specific: add French/Russian/etc. entries with their own `language` and `ipa`.
_ipa_notes: `ipa` is the KOKORO/misaki IPA, written in misaki's US-English phoneme vocabulary so Kokoro accepts it verbatim inside the inline markup. misaki collapses the five US diphthongs to single tokens: A is the vowel in FACE, Y in PRICE, O in GOAT, W in MOUTH, I in CHOICE; primary stress is the vertical tick before the stressed syllable. Each `ipa` string was validated end-to-end through misaki.en.G2P (lang_code 'a') — see test_local706_kokoro_pronunciation.py. This is NOT the alphabet AWS Polly expects, so the Polly SSML path uses the respelling (sub alias) and NOT `ipa`; set the optional per-entry `polly_ipa` (standard IPA) only if you want Polly to use an SSML phoneme element. Leave `ipa` empty to make the Kokoro path substitute the respelling instead of inline markup.

_schema.language: ISO-ish language tag of the NAME's origin (vi, fr, ru, ...)
_schema.written: canonical written form shown to the reader (diacritics intact)
_schema.ipa: misaki/Polly IPA, or empty string to use the respelling
_schema.respelling: approximate English phonetic guide; the spoken fallback
_schema.variants: written forms seen in the wild that must normalise to `written`
